description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the script at `~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/shared-context.py` and the shared directory at `~/.openclaw/workspace/shared/`. 2. The agent must invoke `python3 scripts/shared-context.py add-trend --source <name> --topic '<topic>' --score <int>` at least 3 times with at least 2 distinct --source values. The --score flag must be an integer (not a float or string). 3. The agent must invoke `python3 scripts/shared-context.py add-highlight --source <name> --title '<title>' --summary '<summary>'` at least 2 times with at least 2 distinct --source values. 4. The agent must invoke `python3 scripts/shared-context.py cleanup --hours 48` to remove the pre-seeded 72-hour-old legacy-agent entries from highlights.json while preserving the freshly written entries. 5. The final state must have trends.json with >=3 valid trend objects (source, topic, score as int, timestamp) and highlights.json with >=2 valid, recent highlight objects (source, title, summary, timestamp), with the two stale legacy-agent entries removed.
